title: UIBC SCITT/COSE verdict line
description: One line of the JSON Lines file produced by `uibc verify-cose`. It describes what the verifier decided about one Transparent Statement under the aee-scitt-cose/v0.1 profile, and why. It is a second shape rather than the package report, because that report names failing checks as S-ids and this profile refuses on named faults (a missing inclusion proof, a deprecated algorithm) that no S-number describes.

vector.description: The corpus member's id, or the file name when judging one statement.

verdict.description: valid = the statement satisfied every stage the profile requires; invalid = it was refused, and `codes` says on what ground. A verifier that cannot read the bytes also answers invalid, with code `unreadable`, because a reader that reports nothing has not reported a verdict.

codes.description: Refusal codes, in the order the profile's stages found them. Empty exactly when the verdict is valid.

notes.description: What the verifier observed: the reason behind each code, and the observer position a relying party needs (vantage, layer, whether the observed party could reach the recorder).

conforms_to_expected.description: Whether this verdict conforms to what the corpus member declares. Null when the caller did not supply a corpus member, which is the case for a single vector file.

exit.description: 0 valid, 1 refused. There is no 3: an unreadable statement is a refusal with code `unreadable`, not a crash.
